client_rating_basis: client.rating is the average score FREELANCERS gave this client after working with them (total_reviews is how many rated them), not the client's rating of freelancers and not a measure of the client's own success. A low rating is other freelancers reporting a bad experience with this client — surface it when the user is deciding whether to apply.

jobs.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
We are a B2B software company building a multi-tenant Laravel platform for industrial sites. We are hiring a hands-on Head of Engineering and need an experienced engineer to run the technical interviews and give us a written, independent assessment of each candidate. You interview; we make the hiring decision.

Scope

Four to five candidate interviews over two to three weeks, scheduled by us. Each interview is 90 minutes in two parts:
- Part 1 (45 min): technical depth. Laravel and PHP in production, PostgreSQL, Inertia.js with Vue 3, multi-tenant design, security practice. Questions probe real decisions they made, not textbook answers.
- Part 2 (45 min): live problem. You bring one realistic scenario (taking over an unfamiliar Laravel codebase, a data model issue, a tenant isolation flaw) and the candidate works through it with you, with their AI coding tools if they use them.

Within 24 hours of each interview, a written assessment of one page scored 1 to 5 on five criteria, with evidence for each score:
1. Laravel and PHP depth in production
2. Data modelling, PostgreSQL and multi-tenant design
3. Codebase takeover and stabilisation judgement
4. Security practice
5. Use of AI coding tools and the judgement to review what they produce
Plus a clear recommendation: hire, hire as senior engineer not lead, or no.

One 30-minute call with us after the batch to compare candidates.

You

- 8+ years in software engineering, with Laravel in production in the last three years
Have hired or interviewed senior engineers before and can tell a strong résumé from a strong engineer
- Comfortable interviewing in English over video; candidates are mainly in Egypt and Jordan, interviews fall Sunday to Thursday
- Not affiliated with any candidate

Terms

- Fixed price per interview including the written assessment (State your price per interview in your proposal).
- Start within one week. Signed NDA.

To be considered, send: your Laravel experience in two lines, one example of a senior hire you assessed and what you looked for, and your price per interview.
</untrusted_participant_content>

jobs.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
Sachamama is a climate action nonprofit working with the Latino community in the United States. We are building a conversational agent (web and WhatsApp) as a module of our internal platform, built on Laravel 13 + Filament 5. This contract covers the first deliverable: the agent engine.
The project is developed 100% with AI assistance in Cursor. Our IT team defines the architecture, validates the code and integrates the deliverable. We are looking for someone who works within that architecture, gives the AI precise instructions, reads and understands every change, and delivers with tests and evidence. The quality of what you deliver matters more than speed.
What you will build
• A new Agente module inside our platform, following the structure of the existing modules.
• A knowledge base editable from the admin panel (Filament), with permissions per program.
• An interchangeable AI provider layer, with Gemini as the first provider.
• The conversational engine: detects language (Spanish/English), classifies the user's intent among 9 types, recommends Sachamama content and actions, and follows strict scope rules.
• An API endpoint for the web channel and a log of every message.
• An admin screen where our team can test the agent.
How we work
• You receive the functional specification, the architecture, the Cursor rules and the task list for the deliverable.
• Before starting, you propose your task plan and we approve it.
• The deliverable is submitted as a GitHub pull request with passing automated tests, an agent evaluation report run against a set of 30 test messages, and a checklist signed off by you.
• Our team handles quality testing and integration.
</untrusted_participant_content>
